guarantees.claim: mux_sel_err always equals the bitwise OR of mux_sel_err_i and mr_err.

uncertain_points.claim: No glitch filtering is present on mux_sel_err_i or mr_err; transient glitches could propagate to mux_sel_err and momentarily select the error path.
uncertain_points.cond: when either mux_sel_err_i or mr_err toggles asynchronously or with timing hazard
uncertain_points.risk: False error mux selection may cause unintended data clearing, control corruption, or observable side-channel leakage in the AES cipher control path.
